newsitem.title: GERMANY: BayernLB says not interested in Napoli.
newsitem.headline: BayernLB says not interested in Napoli.

text.p: Bayerische Landesbank on Tuesday denied reports that it was among possible bidders for Italy's Banco di Napoli.
"Reports from Italy that Bayerische Landesbank is aiming for a stake in Banco di Napoli have no basis in reality," the state-owned German bank said in a brief statement.
"Bayerische Landesbank sees itself well-positioned in the Italian market, there is thus no interest in an involvement in Banco di Napoli."
Newspaper reports in Italy have speculated that Bayerische Landesbank was among a group of banks considering separate bids for control of the bank which has recently been making huge losses.
